Terms.title: Terms of Service

Home.badge: Governed AI coworkers · Operated in the EU
Home.heroBody: Give your team AI coworkers that work in company systems — with access control, human approval, an audit trail, and a cost budget.
Home.chatUserText: Léna, reply to the complaint email based on the policy.
Home.chatAgentText: I checked the customer in the CRM database: the complaint is valid, and per the knowledge base they are entitled to a refund within 14 days.
Home.chatDraftText: Dear Gábor, we will of course refund the purchase amount today.
Home.featureCoworkersBody: The AI coworker reads email, drafts documents, and carries work through — in your tools, under your rules.
Home.featureAccessBody: You decide who and which AI coworker can access what. Sensitive actions wait for a human before anything is sent.
Home.featureAuditBody: Every step is logged: who asked for what, which data the AI touched, what went out. You can review it later.
Home.featureAdminBody: The company administrator sets who can trust the AI with what: roles, data and tool access, autonomy level, and cost budget.
Home.featureModelsBody: We do not lock you to one vendor. You can pick a model per AI coworker — and switch whenever a better or cheaper option appears.
Home.howStep1Body: The company administrator sets who may work with which AI coworker, on which data, and with how much autonomy.
Home.howStep2Body: In chat, as a task, or as a scheduled process. The AI coworker carries it through in company systems.
Home.howStep3Title: A human decides at the sensitive points
Home.howStep3Body: Outbound email, file sharing, payments: an approval card, one click.
Home.aboutBody: Excellence AI is operated by Excellence Pay Kft. The platform lets company employees do real office work with AI coworkers — mail, documents, internal knowledge, approved processes — without losing control of data and permissions. Connecting external accounts is always optional, and the details are in the privacy notice.
Home.aboutCardLead: <brand>Excellence AI</brand> is a governed enterprise AI coworker platform operated by Excellence Pay Kft. It helps organizations give employees AI agents that work on company tools under access control, audit logging, privacy safeguards, and human approval.
Home.aboutCardRest: The product is not a public consumer chatbot. It is a signed-in workspace where invited company members run governed AI agents. External account connections are always optional and described in detail in the privacy documents. See the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms</terms>.
Home.ctaTitle: Your first AI coworker is waiting.
Home.ctaBody: A closed, invitation-only workspace. Sign in with your company account and put the first one to work.
